  within the observation window differ

  entrant who stopped out and returned qualifies). The last column
  gives the same difference among all entrants with such an
  attempt (the cohort holds 10,027 entrants), whatever their
  later enrollment. Parentheses hold 95\% intervals:
  a Wald interval for a difference, in percentage points, and the
  log (Woolf) method for the odds ratio. Subjects with at least
  400 later-observed entrants, ordered by the number with
  a DFW. An entrant can appear in several rows. The comparisons are
  unadjusted and descriptive, they were computed after the analysis
  plans were frozen, and they do not establish the order of the
  course outcome and the change of major.}
